gen-dafont-dogica-gf-matangi: Chunky and wide-spaced, Dogica sits low and heavy over Matangi. Matangi's twine-like strokes and open round letters are the best thing here, a soft, hefty body against a rigid heading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro has a welcoming gap in its c and lines bent like paperclip wire, with no swelling anywhere. And Dogica above it stays heavy and widely spaced, so a longer stretch of text feels light under a blunt heading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-miriam-libre: Dogica's lowercase nearly climbs to capital height, spaced wide. Miriam Libre's wire-drawn sans strokes and generous s bends give the pair its strongest quality: sturdy letters, each one drawn with a single simple tip.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Dogica's lowercase nearly matches its capitals, spaced out wide and heavy. Mochiy Pop P One answers with sans letters of sizable body and generous spacing, so both fonts fill the page with the same plain, unswelling line.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-montserrat-underlin: Montserrat Underline reads open and marker-plain, with round bowls that never swell. And over a longer passage, its oversized lowercase keeps the sans text moving smoothly beneath Dogica's heavy, wide-spaced heading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline reads big-bodied and friendly, with a splayed c terminal giving its sans-serif letters some character. But Dogica's heavy, wide-set heading sits above it, so a long page feels sturdy yet easy to move through.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-mozilla-text: Dogica keeps its lowercase tall, almost level with its capitals, and spreads every letter wide with openings at each curve end. Mozilla Text brings flared terminals and tall bodies.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-nata-sans: Dogica spreads heavy, wide-set letters whose lowercase nearly reaches capital height. Nata Sans then takes over with a large central band and open curves, the steadiness of a technical pen where Dogica simply hits hard.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-nobile: Nobile keeps its lowercase close to cap height and leaves its curves open like unjoined chalk arcs. And Dogica, heavy and widely tracked, shares that tall-lowercase habit, which is what ties the two together.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-nokora: Dense and dark, Nokora lays a thick stripe of lowercase through each line, with a wide-open s that never tightens. Dogica's heavy, spaced-out heading stands over it, and both feel solid.
